Monte Carlo stability of sampled traversal quantiles across seeds

Source: R/path_burden_traversals.R
traversal_stability.Rd

Reruns path_burden_traversals() with method = "sample" for each seed and reports the weighted 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of the traversal totals (GfS+ points), with their range across seeds.

Usage

traversal_stability(qsf, seeds = 1:5, n_draws = 10000L, ...)

Arguments

qsf

As in path_burden_traversals().

seeds

Seeds to run.

n_draws

Draws per route per seed.

...

Passed to path_burden_traversals().

Value

A list: per_seed (tibble seed, p10, median, p90) and range (tibble with rows min, max, spread).
